compliance.title: Panadiga Hardware Safety & Operational Briefing
compliance.subtitle: Mandatory physical and forensic invariants for Panasonic DMR-EH55 bench sessions.
compliance.flowStep1: 1. Connect Pico Probe to P7501 (115200 8N1) and verify 3.3V VDD & pin states (PINCHECK).
compliance.flowStep2: 2. Capture and sanitize NVRAM top-boot microsectors SA134..SA141 (0x807F0000) to clear U99.
compliance.flowStep3: 3. Inspect HDD MEIHFS partitions and MBR 'SH' mirrors non-destructively with SHA-256 verification.
compliance.flowStep4: 4. Generate SD Unbrick kits (DIGADIAG.FRM / PANA__SD.FRM) or analyze PANA_DVD.FRM cryptograms.
compliance.docksGuideDesc: Use the bottom status bar to toggle the Left Commands dock, Right Live Telemetry dock, and Bottom P7501 Serial Console from any module.
compliance.invVoltage: 3.3V LVTTL Only & NSW5V Hi-Z (GP3): P7501 Pin 5 carries ~5.15V upstream via D7510; keep GP3 strictly as Hi-Z Input without pulls — NEVER drive push-pull.
compliance.invXreset: Open-Drain XRESET (Pin 2 / GP5): Pull LOW or Hi-Z only; never actively drive +3.3V push-pull onto XRESET.
compliance.invBackpower: No P7501 Backpowering: Never power the Raspberry Pi Pico from P7501; always supply Pico via USB or VSYS.
compliance.invNorHdd: IPL & Forensics Protection: Spansion IPL SA0..SA3 (0x80000000..0x8003FFFF) is permanent read-only (E05); raw HDD dumps are immutable evidence.
compliance.checkboxLabel: I understand the 3.3V LVTTL, NSW5V Hi-Z, Open-Drain XRESET, and immutable forensic invariants.
compliance.reopenHint: You can reopen this safety briefing anytime from the status bar shield button.

guidance.title: Stage Guidance
guidance.hintDashboard: Verify Pico link, binary inventory, and overall U99 recovery readiness.
guidance.hintPico: Validate P7501 pinout (PINCHECK), monitor 3.3V VDD, and drive SC0 / GDB sessions.
guidance.hintNvram: Inspect Spansion S29JL064H microsectors SA134..SA141 and perform safe U99 erasure.
guidance.hintHdd: Audit MEIHFS MBR 'SH', LBA 57344 mirror, WAL journal, and capacity locks non-destructively.
guidance.hintFrm: Decrypt and inspect PANA_DVD.FRM blocks, entropy metrics, and Feistel ECB signatures.
guidance.hintUnbrick: Build verified DIGADIAG.FRM / PANA__SD.FRM kits and configure MAIN TBC passthrough.
guidance.hintHex: Inspect raw binary offsets, LBA boundaries, and 16-bit/32-bit structures.
guidance.hintManuals: Search 30 indexed Panasonic service manuals, schematics, and IC pinouts.
guidance.hintSettings: Adjust accessibility themes, Basic/Advanced mode, language, and Rust runtime defaults.
guidance.hintIr: Send verified Kaseikyo / Panasonic DIGA IR service commands via Pico GPIO.
